_note: Structured location data for Heroes of the Borderlands. Only publicly verified areas are listed; fill the rest from your booklets. 'status' is runtime state written by the app; the other fields are reference.

caves: every room number and name inside A-K except C3 and G6

locations.name: Region 1 — The Trail
locations.summary: The road between the Keep and the Caves. Works approached from the south.
locations.dm: Best opening scene. Run Looted Wagon → Game Trail → Bandit Ambush in that order to teach combat, exploration and social in one session.

locations.name: Region 2 — The Woods
locations.summary: The shorter, more dangerous route between the Keep and the Caves.
locations.dm: Use for cult foreshadowing: cultists performing an occult ritual.

locations.name: The Keep — Outer Gatehouse
locations.summary: The only way in. Bartho and Gala challenge everyone who arrives.
locations.dm: First impression of the Keep. They steer the party to the castellan. Long rests are possible anywhere inside the Keep.

locations.name: The Keep — Fortress
locations.summary: Castellan Winvarle and his advisers. The party is briefed here on the Caves of Chaos.
locations.dm: Winvarle is the quest-giver. This is where the sandbox opens up.

locations.name: The Keep — Area 8, Traveller's Inn
locations.summary: Beds and rest. Haldryck can be found here.
locations.dm: Haldryck is the party's first friendly contact and a natural ally for a two-player table.

locations.name: The Keep — Area 9, Tavern
locations.summary: Hot food and rumours. The natural place to dangle quest hooks.
locations.dm: Use NPC card rumours here to point at the Caves, the temple, and the bandits.

locations.name: The Keep — Area 11, Temple
locations.summary: The Keep's temple. Its previous priest, Ivlis, left under mysterious circumstances.
locations.dm: The long fuse on the Ivlis reveal. Plant it early, pay it off in the Caves.

locations.name: The Caves of Chaos — Canyon
locations.summary: A honeycomb of caves cut into a canyon a few miles from the Keep. Factions hold each mouth.
locations.dm: No long rests here. Each cleared cave is the level track. Factions can be played against each other.

locations.name: Cave C — Nothic Lair
locations.summary: Contains C3 Library, and an iron tome describing the Chaos Bell and how to destroy it.
locations.dm: Key lore cave. Delivering the iron tome here is the campaign's main turn.

locations.name: Cave E — Ogre Lair
locations.summary: Oggdug, an ogre mercenary, lairs here.
locations.dm: Oggdug will talk about the Cult if asked about his off-limits caves. He is recruitable — very valuable to a two-PC party.

locations.name: Cave G — Shunned Caves
locations.summary: An owlbear killed Zurf here. Contains G6 Cult Barrack.
locations.dm: Cultists can be met in G6 — the most direct way to reveal the cult.

locations.name: Cave K — Shrine of Evil Chaos
locations.summary: The cult's shrine. Reanimated Zurf serves as bodyguard here.
locations.dm: Endgame location. The Chaos Bell is the payoff.
